**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — Article VIX of the E-Path FX license is disclaimer-only: the Licensed Technology is delivered "AS IS," all express and implied warranties are disclaimed, and Licensor expressly declines to warrant error-free operation or that nonconformities to documentation will be corrected. There is no affirmative performance warranty, period, or remedy anywhere in the Agreement — the playbook walk-away position.

Redline submitted (validated ok:true):
- **p0110** — prefaced the AS IS disclaimer with "EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTY SET FORTH BELOW IN THIS ARTICLE," so the disclaimer no longer swallows the express warranty.
- **After p0116** — inserted an EXPRESS WARRANTY paragraph: professional and workmanlike services; 12-month software / 90-day services conformance to documentation and specifications; compliance with applicable laws; no viruses or malicious code; remedy of re-performance, repair/replacement, or refund of fees at Licensor's option.

Fallback offered in the comment: 90 days for software and 30 days for services with the same remedies.
